basics.name: Hector Olea
basics.label: Full-Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full-Stack Developer with 12 years of experience building and scaling robust applications. I specialize in the Java and microservices ecosystem to deliver highly testable and maintainable software, reducing long-term costs and accelerating feature development. My approach is grounded in a commitment to quality through clean code, comprehensive testing strategies, and modern DevOps practices.

jobs.summary: Supported and maintained an Insurance Angular application backed by two Java-based microservices.
highlights: Refactored 30% of the Java codebase to align with Spring Boot best practices, improving maintainability and scalability.
Introduced JUnit testing to the microservices, increasing code coverage from 0% to 20% and enhancing overall code quality and reliability.

jobs.summary: Supported a Financial Analytics application, ensuring its stability and performance.
highlights: Resolved incidents and tasks efficiently using ServiceNow, addressing user-reported issues and implementing timely solutions to minimize downtime.

jobs.summary: Developed a microservice for Banking application to merge customer database information using an SSN identifier.
highlights: Enhanced microservices responsible for storing case and product information by adding new features, increasing functionality and user satisfaction.
Implemented initial tests for existing microservices, enhancing reliability.

jobs.summary: Maintained, supported, and developed new features for 15 microservices built with Spring Boot and Node.js, ensuring high performance and scalability.
highlights: Automated daily support tasks by creating bash and Python scripts, improving efficiency and reducing manual effort.
Successfully migrated to the Walmart Cloud Native platform, achieving cost reduction, faster deployment, auto-scaling, and enhanced maintainability.
Migrated Event Hubs and Armory to Apache Kafka, improving service resilience and minimizing event loss.
Implemented fault-tolerant approaches for HTTP clients and databases, ensuring system reliability under high loads.
Resolved critical vulnerabilities by upgrading the Spring Boot version, updating Docker base images, and modernizing project dependencies.

jobs.summary: Automated repetitive processes in Airline Company to streamline operations, reducing manual effort and improving efficiency for the operations team.
highlights: Developed Python and bash scripts to automate services to enhance monitoring and reporting capabilities.
Designed and implemented REST APIs to automate incident management in ServiceNow, reducing response times and improving workflow efficiency.

jobs.summary: Supported and Maintained an Invoicing application capable of retrieving transactions from plain text files via FTP interfaces, ensuring seamless data integration and processing.
highlights: Optimized SQL queries and PL/SQL procedures in an Oracle database, improving query performance and system efficiency.
Implemented SQL Loader to rapidly load and save thousands of transactions, enhancing data processing speed and reducing manual effort.

jobs.summary: Maintained and supported the SIMBAD database system, which housed census data for Mexico, ensuring accuracy and optimal performance.
